mathematical_meanings: Left image: The symbol "O" marks the origin at the intersection of the coordinate axes. Right image: The symbol "O" names the common point of the rays that form an angle.
Rationales: The left occurrence is O at the axes' intersection between the separated branches. The right occurrence is O at the common endpoint of the rays forming the marked right angle. The left placement shows that the symbol marks the origin at the intersection of the coordinate axes, while the right placement shows that it names the common point of the rays that form an angle.
